bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the impact of diacritic stripping and inconsistent Unicode normalization on NLP tasks, including measuring tokenization bloat in LLMs (LLaMA, mBERT, XLM-RoBERTa) across different languages (Spanish, Arabic, Hebrew), comparing dependency parsing performance on un-normalized versus normalized data (Hindi), and analyzing machine translation errors caused by inconsistent diacritization.
